items.title: Joseph Rene and Edna Kelly Interview, 1969-12-15
items.q: Well, every day George Lewis used to be at our house. He used to stay there almost.

ctx.x: Did he see George Lewis very often or was it just to meet you?
Well, every day George Lewis used to be at our house. He used to stay there almost. Really? Sure. Every day.
What was George like? What sort of a fashion?
